description: Fix an array-sort-based priority queue that re-sorts on push (losing FIFO order for equal priorities across interleaved pops) into a genuinely stable one
prompts: pq.ts's StablePriorityQueue keeps an array and re-sorts it on every push by priority alone. Array.prototype.sort is stable in modern engines, but re-sorting the WHOLE array on every push does not preserve original insertion order for equal-priority items once items have been popped and re-pushed in between (the relative array positions get scrambled by intervening sorts). Fix push/pop so that: (1) items with a lower priority number come out first, and (2) items with EQUAL priority always come out in the order they were originally pushed (FIFO) - track insertion order explicitly with a counter, don't rely on array position across separate sorts. The file must compile under tsc --strict.
name: add_ts_stable_priority_queue

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit pq.ts
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build pq.ts
node behavior_test.js
